articles.title: Hyderabad Nurse's Death: Minor Driver Was Headed for Joyride at Farmhouse When Fatal Crash Occurred
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: The 17-year-old boy accused of fatally running over a nurse in Hyderabad's Asif Nagar area was allegedly on his way to a farmhouse in Moinabad for a joyride with two friends when the accident occurred on Sunday morning, police said.

body.html:
The 17-year-old boy accused of fatally running over a nurse in Hyderabad's Asif Nagar area was allegedly on his way to a farmhouse in Moinabad for a joyride with two friends when the accident occurred on Sunday morning, police said.

According to investigators, the trio—comprising two minors and an adult—had initially planned to travel by bus but later decided to hire a car after one of them suggested the idea.

Police said the boys had driven the vehicle barely 300 metres from the pickup point when the minor driver allegedly struck 42-year-old nurse Faheem Unissa, who was on her way to work.

"The three were on a trial run of the car when the accident took place," said A Ramanjaneyulu, Sub-Inspector of Asif Nagar Police Station.

Investigators said the boys fled the scene after the collision and returned the SUV to the acquaintance who had arranged the vehicle. They allegedly claimed the vehicle was unsuitable for their trip and attributed the damage to a minor collision with another vehicle.

Unaware that the nurse had succumbed to her injuries while undergoing treatment at Osmania General Hospital, the trio then travelled to Moinabad by bus and spent the day at a farmhouse.

Initially, police registered a case under Section 106 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) for causing death by negligence. Following the victim's death, the case was later altered to Section 105 (culpable homicide not amounting to murder), and the minor driver was booked under the provision.

Police said the other individuals involved, including the person who facilitated access to the vehicle, would face charges related to abetment.

According to investigators, the boys had informed their parents that they would be travelling by bus and did not disclose their decision to hire a vehicle. The trio allegedly approached an acquaintance who had access to a car available for rent.

During the investigation, police traced the acquaintance, who informed officers that he was not the owner of the SUV and had himself obtained it from another person.

Assistant Commissioner of Police K. Srinivas said the vehicle ultimately belonged to Basheer, who operates a self-drive car rental business. The SUV had allegedly been rented to another individual before being passed on to the acquaintance approached by the boys.

After gathering these details, police contacted the parents and located the boys in Moinabad. They were subsequently brought to the police station for questioning.

Police said the two minors will be produced before the Juvenile Justice Board following their arrest. Further investigation is underway.

articles.title: Kolkata Customer Alleges Delivery Partner Marked Order Delivered and Left With Food
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A CCTV video from Kolkata has gone viral after a customer alleged that a food delivery partner falsely marked his order as delivered before allegedly leaving the location with the package.

body.html:
A CCTV video from Kolkata has gone viral after a customer alleged that a food delivery partner falsely marked his order as delivered before allegedly leaving the location with the package.

The incident has sparked debate on social media over the reliability of food delivery services and the need for stronger delivery verification systems.

The customer, identified as Sumit Chakraborty, shared footage from his home CCTV camera showing the delivery partner arriving outside his residence.

According to Chakraborty, the delivery executive uploaded a photograph of the gate and marked the order as "Delivered" on the app. However, the CCTV footage allegedly shows the delivery partner leaving the premises with the food instead of handing it over to the customer.

After reviewing the footage, Chakraborty said he submitted the CCTV recording to the food delivery platform and requested a detailed investigation into the incident. He also sought a full refund and action against the delivery partner.

The viral video has drawn widespread attention online, with many users saying it highlights the importance of CCTV footage in resolving delivery-related disputes. Several social media users questioned how orders can be marked as completed without stronger customer verification measures.

The incident triggered hundreds of reactions online, with some users claiming they had faced similar issues involving food deliveries and courier services where packages were marked as delivered despite not being received.

Many users called for OTP-based delivery confirmation for food orders, arguing that it could reduce the chances of false delivery claims. Others pointed out that customers without CCTV cameras may find it difficult to prove such complaints.

While some criticised customer support systems, others urged people not to draw conclusions until the company completes its investigation. A section of users also noted that the viral clip may not necessarily show the complete sequence of events.

The incident has once again brought attention to delivery verification practices used by online food platforms, with many customers awaiting the company's response and any measures that may be introduced to strengthen delivery security and customer trust.

#Kolkata #ViralVideo #FoodDelivery #CustomerComplaint

articles.title: Former Gram Panchayat President Booked for Allegedly Threatening Woman PDO in Kolar
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: An alleged attempt to assault a Panchayat Development Officer (PDO) has been reported from Annihalli village in Karnataka's Kolar taluk, where a former Gram Panchayat president has been accused of abusing and threatening a woman officer.

body.html:
An alleged attempt to assault a Panchayat Development Officer (PDO) has been reported from Annihalli village in Karnataka's Kolar taluk, where a former Gram Panchayat president has been accused of abusing and threatening a woman officer.

According to a complaint filed by Savitha, PDO of Annihalli Gram Panchayat, former Gram Panchayat president Annihalli Nagaraj allegedly attempted to assault her and used abusive language during a dispute related to development funds and the installation of streetlights in the village.

Police said the incident occurred during an argument over local development works, following which Savitha approached the authorities and lodged a formal complaint.

Based on the complaint, Kolar Rural Police registered a case against Nagaraj under relevant provisions of law and initiated an investigation.

A video purportedly showing the incident has also surfaced on social media, drawing public attention and sparking discussions about the safety of government officials while discharging their duties.

In her complaint, Savitha sought police protection, alleging that she has been facing repeated threats and harassment and is working under fear and stress.

Police said the matter is under investigation and further action will be taken based on the finding.

articles.title: Pune Real Estate Director's ‘Accidental Fall’ Turns Murder Case; Fiancée and Her Alleged Lover Ar
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a major twist in the death of real estate firm director Ketan Vishal Agrawal, Pune Rural Police have arrested his fiancée and her alleged lover for allegedly conspiring to murder him by pushing him into a deep gorge at Lohagad Fort and attempting to pass it off as an accident.

body.html:
In a major twist in the death of real estate firm director Ketan Vishal Agrawal, Pune Rural Police have arrested his fiancée and her alleged lover for allegedly conspiring to murder him by pushing him into a deep gorge at Lohagad Fort and attempting to pass it off as an accident.

The incident occurred on June 18 and was initially believed to be an accidental fall during a trek at the historic fort. Agrawal (26), a resident of Gahunje in Pune district and a director in his family's real estate business, was found dead in a gorge after reportedly falling nearly 400 feet.

At the time, police had registered an accidental death report based on a statement by his fiancée, Siya Goyal, who claimed that Agrawal had slipped and fallen while the couple was visiting the fort.

Agrawal and Goyal were scheduled to marry later this year, with their families reportedly having made elaborate wedding arrangements, including booking a palace in Udaipur for the ceremony.

However, Superintendent of Police Sandip Singh Gill said investigators found several suspicious circumstances surrounding the death, prompting a detailed probe.

During the investigation, police examined multiple angles, including financial disputes and personal relationships. Investigators allegedly discovered that Goyal was in a relationship with Chetan Babulal Chaudhary (22), a resident of Kondhwa in Pune.

According to police, Goyal was unwilling to marry Agrawal and viewed him as an obstacle to her relationship with Chaudhary. Investigators alleged that the two conspired to eliminate Agrawal.

Police claim that Goyal took Agrawal to Lohagad Fort under the pretext of an outing, while Chaudhary was called to the location later. The duo allegedly pushed Agrawal into the gorge, resulting in his death.

Based on emerging evidence, the Local Crime Branch detained Chaudhary for questioning. During interrogation, investigators alleged that he revealed details of the conspiracy. Goyal was subsequently arrested.

Following a complaint lodged by Agrawal's father, Vishal Agrawal, Lonavala Rural Police registered a case under relevant provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita relating to murder and criminal conspiracy.

Meanwhile, an emotional Instagram post shared by Goyal shortly after Agrawal's death has resurfaced on social media. The post featured a video montage expressing grief and included messages questioning why he had left her despite her love for him.

The post had initially drawn widespread sympathy when the incident was believed to be a trekking accident. However, following the arrests and allegations made by investigators, the post has become a subject of intense public discussion.

Police said further investigation is underway to establish the exact sequence of events, gather forensic evidence and determine whether any other individuals were involved in the alleged conspiracy.

articles.title: CCTV Captures Fatal Highway Accident in Udupi: Pedestrian Killed While Crossing NH-66
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 45-year-old man lost his life after being hit by a speeding car while attempting to cross National Highway 66 near Kota Circle in Karnataka's Udupi district on Sunday evening. The incident, captured on CCTV, has gone viral on social media.

body.html:
A 45-year-old man lost his life after being hit by a speeding car while attempting to cross National Highway 66 near Kota Circle in Karnataka's Udupi district on Sunday evening.

The incident, captured on CCTV, has gone viral on social media. The deceased has been identified as Satish Acharya, a resident of Aruru in Brahmavara.

According to police, Satish was crossing the highway near Kota Circle when a car travelling from Kundapura towards Mangaluru struck him. CCTV footage shows the pedestrian attempting to cross the road while signalling with his hand before being hit by the oncoming vehicle.

The impact was severe, throwing the victim into the air and causing critical head and leg injuries.

Local residents rushed to his aid and shifted him to a private hospital in Koteshwar. However, doctors declared him dead on arrival.

Police said Satish had visited the Amruteshwari Temple in Kota and was crossing the highway towards Hadikere when the accident occurred.

Officers from Kota Police Station visited the scene, conducted a preliminary investigation and registered a case. Further investigation is underway to determine the circumstances surrounding the accident.

The disturbing CCTV footage has sparked discussions on road safety, pedestrian awareness and speeding on national highways.

articles.title: Rare Tornado Spotted in Tamil Nadu: Funnel Cloud Touches Ground Near Thoothukudi
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A rare weather phenomenon was witnessed in Tamil Nadu's Thoothukudi district on June 21 when a narrow funnel cloud descended from a thunderstorm and briefly touched the ground, forming what meteorologists have identified as a tornado.

body.html:
A rare weather phenomenon was witnessed in Tamil Nadu's Thoothukudi district on June 21 when a narrow funnel cloud descended from a thunderstorm and briefly touched the ground, forming what meteorologists have identified as a tornado.

Videos shared by weather observers, including Tamil Nadu Weatherman, and verified by meteorologist Navdeep Dahiya showed a slender, twisting funnel extending from a dark thundercloud and making contact with the ground, stirring up dust before dissipating.

Experts said the tornado appeared to be weak, narrow and short-lived, and no major damage has been reported. However, meteorologists noted that even a relatively weak tornado can pose risks and should not be taken lightly.

A tornado is a rapidly rotating column of air that connects a thundercloud to the ground. It becomes visible when moisture condenses into water droplets inside the funnel, while dust and debris are lifted from the surface.

According to weather experts, tornado formation generally requires warm and moisture-rich air, a strong updraft within a thunderstorm, and a source of atmospheric rotation near the ground. The Bay of Bengal often provides abundant moisture during the monsoon season, creating conditions favourable for severe weather.

Forecasters believe the Thoothukudi event was likely a "landspout" — a weaker form of tornado that develops from rotation near the surface rather than from a large rotating thunderstorm system.

Tornadoes are relatively uncommon in India and are most frequently reported in eastern states such as West Bengal and Odisha during the pre-monsoon months of March to May. Weather records indicate that a majority of India's tornadoes occur in the northeastern region.

Meteorologists say tornadoes in Tamil Nadu are exceptionally rare because the state's monsoon thunderstorms do not usually organise in the same manner as the powerful storm systems associated with tornado outbreaks elsewhere in the world.

The sighting has generated significant interest among weather enthusiasts and experts, who describe it as one of the rare instances of a confirmed tornado being captured on video in southern India.

articles.title: UP Reel Creator Arrested for Allegedly Harassing Schoolgirls, Hundreds of Videos Found on Phone
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A youth identified as Robin, a resident of the Khatauli area in Uttar Pradesh's Muzaffarnagar district, has been arrested for allegedly harassing schoolgirls and women while filming social media reels.

body.html:
A youth identified as Robin, a resident of the Khatauli area in Uttar Pradesh's Muzaffarnagar district, has been arrested for allegedly harassing schoolgirls and women while filming social media reels.

According to police, Robin used to record videos of female students and women passing through public places, making romantic and obscene gestures while using popular film songs in the background. He allegedly uploaded the videos on his Instagram account, "IM ROBIN".

The matter came to light after several school and college students complained that the accused regularly filmed them without consent while standing along roads and public areas. Locals alleged that he often captured the faces of girls and women in his videos and uploaded the content online.

Residents claimed that many female students were forced to change their daily routes to avoid him, resulting in delays in reaching school and returning home. Concerned parents reportedly remained worried about their daughters' safety.

The issue escalated when some students informed their parents, who subsequently approached senior police officials with complaints. Acting on the complaints, police launched an investigation and arrested the accused.

During the investigation, police reportedly recovered hundreds of videos from the accused's mobile phone. Officials said the videos allegedly showed him obstructing female students and women while recording reels for social media.

A video that surfaced after his arrest shows the accused walking towards a police station, apologising and admitting his mistake.

The case gained significant attention on social media, with several users demanding action from the Uttar Pradesh Police after videos of the accused went viral online.

Parents and local residents welcomed the police action, stating that strict measures against such behaviour are necessary to ensure that women and students can travel without fear or harassment.

Police are continuing their investigation and examining the digital evidence recovered from the accused's mobile phone.

articles.title: SOG Officer Collapses During Gym Workout in Uttarakhand, Dies at 38
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A tragic incident has been reported from Uttarakhand's Champawat district, where 38-year-old SOG officer Girish Bhatt collapsed while working out at a gym in Banbasa and was later declared dead at a hospital.

body.html:
A tragic incident has been reported from Uttarakhand's Champawat district, where 38-year-old SOG officer Girish Bhatt collapsed while working out at a gym in Banbasa and was later declared dead at a hospital.

According to officials, Bhatt suddenly felt unwell during his workout on Friday and lost consciousness. People present at the gym rushed him to a private hospital in Khatima, but doctors declared him dead on arrival. While the exact cause of death is yet to be officially confirmed, initial reports suggest a possible cardiac emergency.

A resident of Banbasa and a member of the Champawat Special Operations Group, Bhatt was known for his dedication and role in several important police operations. He is survived by his wife and two sons.

His last rites were performed with full honours at Sharda Ghat, with senior police officials, local leaders and residents paying their final respects.

The incident comes days after the sudden death of national-level bodybuilder Sushil Kumar in Karnataka, renewing discussions around medical emergencies occurring during or after intense workouts, though no official link has been established between the cases.
